sections.heading: Summary
body: The platform met its availability target for the third consecutive quarter. Three incidents occurred, all resolved within the error budget, and none were customer-visible for more than five minutes.
Deployment frequency increased 22% quarter over quarter following the rollout of the new CI pipeline.

sections.heading: Incidents
body: Two incidents were caused by a shared dependency on the legacy session store; its replacement is scheduled for Q4. The third was a cloud-provider network event outside our control.
Post-incident reviews were completed within five working days in all cases.

sections.heading: Next quarter
body: Priorities are the session-store migration, enabling multi-region failover for the API tier, and reducing p99 latency on the search endpoint below 300 ms.
